      • canPush

        protected boolean canPush(@Nonnull
                          org.bukkit.entity.Player player,
                          @Nonnull
                          org.bukkit.entity.LivingEntity entity)
        Checks if the stomper boots can move an entity and is not the player who is using the boots.

        For developers: If you're spawning an immovable NPC, you should be denying collision with LivingEntity#setCollidable(boolean) or gravity with LivingEntity#setGravity(boolean).

        Parameters:
        entity - The LivingEntity to check.
        player - The Player using the StomperBoots.
        Returns:
        If the entity can move.
